title: Pollo Asado

items: 2-4 lbs chicken (breast is fine, thigh is more juicy)

ingredientGroups.title: Citrus-Achiote Marinade
items: 3-4 garlic cloves, roughly chopped or minced

steps: Prepare the marinade by blending all of the ingredients in the blender until homogeneous.
Trim the chicken and marinade for 2 hours, up to a maximum of 4 hours.
Grill over high heat until the chicken reaches 165°F internally, approximately 12–16 minutes.
sourceNote: Substitute with 1-1.5 Tsp of your choice of ground chili pepper.  Different chili peppers produce different flavor profiles; Aleppo for a fruity raisin, Guajillo for a smokiness, or Kashmiri or a neutral taste.
